attempts.text:
**The window starts in the `hyc` hydrogenase stretch.** Columns 0 to 10 are spine, carried by 91 to 100% of chromosomes, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 4% of calls. The model names 89% of genes on average there, but at column 6, `hycF`, it names only 7%, and at column 10, `ascB`, it hesitates most, 1.17 bits.

**Column 11 is a fork at `ascF`**, a PTS transporter subunit EIIB carried by 89% of chromosomes, with a helix-turn-helix protein and a toxin-antitoxin family on its branches. Then columns 12 to 61 run as spine, 91 to 96% carried, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 9% of calls. The model names 97% of genes on average, fewest at column 61, `glaH`, 92%, where it also hesitates most, 0.69 bits.

**Columns 62 to 79 are fork and variable columns**, in a region of plasticity in 31 to 51% of calls, the most plastic stretch of the window. The model names 77% of genes on average, fewest at column 63, `ypjA`, 70%, and hesitates most at column 62, an ATPase, 2.73 bits. Forks at `smpB`, `ratA` and `bamE` carry persistent families beyond the window in some chromosomes, alongside transposase and integrase branches.

**The variable tail fades.** Columns 68 to 79, `recN` to `dgcN`, are carried by 19 to 57% of chromosomes, all persistent families. The window ends at column 79, `dgcN`, in 19% of chromosomes.

**Inside a region of plasticity the model hesitates more than outside**, 2.29 against 0.18 bits, and names fewer genes, 53% against 96%. Over the whole window it names 92% of genes, 0.41 bits on average, perplexity 1.5 families.

label: hypA
facts:
WINDOW: the hypA window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor hypA, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 1,009 to 1,088 from dnaA. Read in 540 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying hypA once); 43,200 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 92% of genes, 0.41 bits on average (perplexity 1.5 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 37,535 calls, named 98%, 0.17 bits; shell 4,594 calls, named 60%, 1.73 bits; cloud 1,071 calls, named 21%, 3.41 bits. Outside an RGP 38,480 calls, named 96%, 0.18 bits; inside an RGP 4,720 calls, named 53%, 2.29 bits. Columns: 61 spine, 5 fork, 14 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (2.29 against 0.18 bits) and names fewer genes (53% against 96%); 4,720 of the 43,200 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 62 ("ATPase") 2.73 bits, RGP 31%; column 63 (ypjA) 2.32 bits, RGP 36%; column 64 (smpB) 2.00 bits, RGP 44%. The 2 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 76%, 1.49 bits on average; the other 78 columns: named 92%, 0.39 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 62-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 31-51%; the least: columns 0-10 (spine), RGP 0-4%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. columns 0-10 (11 columns) spine: share 91-100%, all P, RGP 0-4%. Genes: hypA, hycA, hycB, hycC, hycD, hycE, hycF, hycG, hycH "formate hydrogenlyase assembly prot…", hycI, ascB. named 7-99.8% (mean 89%), fewest named at column 6 (hycF), named 7%; most hesitant at column 10 (ascB), 1.17 bits.
2. column 11 fork: RGP 4%. named 96%; 0.27 bits.
   11: ascF P 89% "PTS transporter subunit EIIB"; also "helix-turn-helix domain-containing prot…" S 26%, "type II toxin-antitoxin system HigB fam…" S 16%
3. columns 12-61 (50 columns) spine: share 91-96%, all P, RGP 0-9%. Genes: ascG, hydN, hypF, norW, norV "anaerobic nitric oxide reductase fl…", norR, gutQ, srlR, gutM, srlD, srlB "PTS glucitol/sorbitol transporter s…", srlE, srlA, mltB, pncC, recA, recX "recombination regulator RecX", alaS, csrA, yqaB "HAD hydrolase-like protein", yqaA "YqaA family protein", gshA, luxS, emrB "multidrug efflux MFS transporter pe…", emrA, emrR, ygaH "AzlD domain-containing protein", ygaZ "L-valine exporter subunit YgaZ", ygaY "MFS transporter", proX, proW "glycine betaine/L-proline ABC trans…", proV, nrdF, nrdE, nrdI "class Ib ribonucleoside-diphosphate…", nrdH, ygaM "DUF883 domain-containing protein", ygaC "YgaC family protein", alaE, stpA, ygaP "thiosulfate sulfurtransferase YgaP", ygaV "helix-turn-helix transcriptional re…", yqaE "YqaE/Pmp3 family membrane protein", kbp, csiR, gabP, gabT "aminotransferase class III-fold pyr…", gabD, lhgO, glaH. named 92-99.6% (mean 97%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 61 (glaH), named 92%, 0.69 bits.
4. columns 62-79 (18 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 31-51%. named 70-82% (mean 77%), fewest named at column 63, named 70%; most hesitant at column 62, 2.73 bits.
   62 fork: "ATPase" P 60%; also "IS1-like element transposase" S 26%
   63 variable: ypjA S 50% "autotransporter outer membrane beta…"
   64 fork: smpB P 62%; also ygaR S 23%
   65 fork: ratA P 62%; also ypjCB S 12%
   66 variable: yfjF P 61% "RnfH family protein"
   67 fork: bamE P 60%; also "tyrosine-type recombinase/integrase" S 10%
   columns 68-79 variable, share 19-57%, all P: recN 57%, nadK 55%, grpE 55%, yfjD "CNNM domain-containing protein" 54%, ypjD "cytochrome c biogenesis protein CcsA" 53%, ffh 51%, rpsP 47%, rimM 43%, trmD 37%, rplS 33%, yfiB "OmpA family protein" 27%, dgcN 19%
